name: Goodfellow AFB
description: Home of the 17th Training Wing, Goodfellow AFB trains intelligence, surveillance, reconnaissance, and fire protection professionals. Major hub for ISR training.

currentNotifications.title: REAL ID Required for Base Access
currentNotifications.body: A REAL ID-compliant driver's license or equivalent is required for base access per DHS mandate.

events.title: Breast Cancer Awareness 5K
events.description: 🎀 Lace up for a cause! 💗 Join us for our Breast Cancer Awareness 5K Run on October 10th from 10-11 AM at the Parade Field . Come run, walk, and show your support as we honor survivors, remember those we've lost, and stand together in the fight against breast cancer. 🏃‍♀️🎀 Sign up now! Wear pink and bring your friends and family! 💕 FMI: 325-654-3242

events.title: Fright Fest Fiesta Texas
events.description: 🎢👻 Ready for thrills, chills, and nonstop fun? Join us for a trip to Six Flags Fiesta Texas Fright Fest! 📅 Saturday, October 10th 🕢 Departure: 11 AM 🕘 Return: 1 AM 📍 Pick-Up & Drop-Off: TRAC Building 109 💲 Cost: $55 per DoD Card Holder Experience heart-pounding rides, haunted attractions, spooky entertainment, and all the excitement Fright Fest has to offer. Don’t miss your chance to enjoy an unforgettable day of thrills with us! Reserve your spot today by calling 325-654-5249. Spots are limited!

No experience necessary, and supplies are included. 🎨🪡 📅 Oct. 10 | 12–3 PM 📅 Oct. 15 | 5–7 PM 📍 Arts & Crafts Bldg. #109 💲 Cost: $17 Advanced reservations required! Call Arts & Crafts at (325) 654-3237 to reserve your spot. 💜 *Anyone under 18 must be accompanied by a parent/guardian*

All skill levels are welcome! FMI: 325-654-3247

events.title: Horseback Riding
events.description: Saddle up for an unforgettable adventure in the Texas Hill Country! Join us for Horseback Riding in the Texas Hill Country on October 17th! Enjoy a 1.5–2 hour trail ride through a beautiful ranch and up into the hills, with plenty of opportunities for photos along the way. After the ride, we’ll head to Fredericksburg, TX for free time to explore, shop, and grab something to eat! events.title: Visual Arts Capitol of Texas Mural Festival II
events.description: Art in Uncommon Places is proud to host the second Visual Arts Capitol of Texas Mural Festival. The Visual Arts Capitol Texas Mural Festival will be held in “The Art Yard” backyard of the AIUP Studio. Join us to watch Texas muralists from Austin, Fort Worth, La Marque, Round Rock, San Antonio, San Marcus and Seguin, join our San Angelo Muralists painting live to our theme, Cowboys and Creatives. events.title: Kids Pumpkin Painting
events.description: 🎃🎨 Get ready for some fall fun! Join us for Kids Pumpkin Painting on October 17 from 12–2 PM ! Kids can paint and decorate their very own pumpkin with all supplies included. 🍂🖌️ 💵 Only $8 📍 Arts & Crafts, Bldg. #109 📞 Call (325) 654-3237 to sign up! ✨ Advanced registration encouraged—walk-ins welcome while supplies last!

events.title: Ceramic Pumpkin Painting
events.description: 🎃🎨 Get creative this Halloween! Join us for Ceramic Pumpkin Painting on October 31 from 12–3 PM at the Arts & Crafts Center! Paint your own ceramic pumpkin and bring your fall vision to life. 🍂🖌️ ✨ $20 includes: ceramic pumpkin, paints & glazes, and firing fees 📍 Arts & Crafts Center, Bldg. #109 👨‍👩‍👧 Open to all ages — anyone under 18 must be accompanied by a parent/guardian. 📞 Advanced reservation required: (325) 654-3237 Spots are limited, so reserve your pumpkin today! 🎃
